rows.grounds: compound of gandha (fragrance) and puṣpa (flower), taken as offering item
ritual lamp offered before the deity
arghya, a ritual offering of water or materials
gerund indicating prior action of arranging the offerings
conjunction completing the list of actions or items

items.question: Which ritual offerings must be arranged before the deity at this stage?
premises: The verse lists gandhapuṣpaṃ, sadhūpaṃ, dīpam, and arghyaṃ as offering items.
The gerund vidhāya indicates that these items are to be arranged.
The conjunctions ca link the listed offerings together.
items.inference: Fragrance and flowers, incense, a lamp, and the arghya offering are to be arranged.
items.plain_english: Having arranged fragrance and flowers, incense, a lamp, and the arghya offering.
